adjudicated: Zero, 2026-10-11 (data lot D-1, through the team lead): the seven sentences as drafted in PREVIEW-kbli-nav-design/D1-whatchanged.md; 01309 and 08996 take option A (the BPS split); 52101 adds the BPS pointer for its reused number. Surfaces: app, website and WhatsApp.
why: Nine client-facing whatChanged fields carried pipeline provenance instead of a sentence for the client: PR numbers, pp28_sources, score=, PNG names, Italian, and internal correction dates. Two of them (01309, 08996) asserted a KBLI 2020 predecessor from an automatic title match that the official BPS table contradicts. Each sentence states only what the record's own bps_2020_ancestors carries, plus, where it says more (a split, a reused number), the BPS Lampiran 10 edge pinned under expect_bps_edges.
